what_it_does: MoE-Inference-Bench provides a comprehensive evaluation suite for Mixture of Experts (MoE) models—large neural networks where different specialized sub-networks handle different types of input—running on NVIDIA H100 GPUs. MoE models are efficient during training but face challenges during inference including unbalanced work distribution across experts and computational overhead in routing decisions. This benchmark systematically measures performance across different model configurations and acceleration techniques.
method_in_detail: The benchmark tests performance variations across batch size, sequence length (input token count), expert dimensions, and number of experts. It evaluates multiple hardware acceleration strategies: pruning (removing unused experts), fused operations (combining multiple computations into single optimized routines), speculative decoding (predicting outputs to reduce latency), reduced precision arithmetic, and parallelization across multiple GPUs.
